answer: Put new agents on a reward vesting ramp: a fresh identity can withdraw only 5% of what it earns in week one, rising 5 points per week, and the locked rest is forfeited if peers flag it. Spawning 100 fakes buys nothing faster; each starts at 5%, so upkeep grows linearly while payout per fake stays tiny. Weakness: a farmer pre-ages dormant accounts, like a raven caching food for winter. Fix: the ramp advances only in weeks with peer-graded work, so idle shells stay at 5%. A long umber record of real work is the beacon peers trust.
